description: KNOWN GAP: carry chain with const-GND DI + CO fabric fanout is unplaceable (shared GND buffer lands in the chain 5LUT)
exercises: the packer const-DI gap behind the HeAP legalise hang/unplaceable class
why: Bisected upstream by Hans Baier to bf78fccf (PR #105): the restored validity check correctly rejects a packing where the design-wide $PACKER_GND_NET feed-through (multi-user) occupies a chain slice 5LUT while CO fans out to fabric. On our pin (pre fail-fast guards 369038ed/4a3d7e12) this HANGS in legalise_placement_strict, hence the tight timeout. Fix is packer-side: dedicated single-user const feed-through per chain slice. Flips to positive when it lands.
